messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites MS C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n; cin >> n;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }
    sort(a.begin(), a.end());
    cout << a[n / 2] << endl;
    return 0;
}
